notes.title: Endings and Updates v1.4.7
notes.content:
Now that The Mortuary Assistant has been released. I wanted to circle back to my previous games and give them some love. My first stop is right here with Our Secret Below.

After enough time working on MA, I decided I simply want players to be able to experience the full story of OSB by experiencing the multiple endings that made me so happy with the game. It certainly wasn't impossible but there are parts that were a bit too opaque. While I haven't simply handed over the keys, I have provided a lot of improvements to make endings 2 and 3 a bit easier to understand how to get.

I have also included a few other improvements including overhauling the input system which now supports key binding.

If you've been a supporter of my work since OSB or before, thank you so so much! For you and new players; if you haven't gotten to experience the different endings of OSB, I hope you do now!

Full patch notes

[list]
[*] Added highlight icons to help guide players to various important places while not revealing anything about puzzles or other aspects. 
[*] Added messaging for achieving ending 2 and ending 3 to help achieve the different endings less opaque.
[*] Various aspects meant to achieve ending 3 now save making it less cumbersome to complete.
[*] Added key binding along with a new input system.
[*] Added keybind prompts for working with a controller and on Steam Deck
[*] Adjusted various events that provide clues for other endings
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not collect the Flashlight or Notes if your inventory was full
[*] Steam Deck support!
[*] Other various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: End Game Experience Improvements
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*]Endings 2 and 3 are now much more fluid to achieve.
[*]Minor quality of life adjustments for item discovery and play
[/list]

After the launch of Our Secret Below, I did some bug fixing and then went right into Kohate for Halloween. Since then, I’ve been working heavily on my next big project: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295920/The_Mortuary_Assistant/]The Mortuary Assistant.[/url] 

I work alone and my focus can only spread so far. However, I never want to just ignore my projects so I took some time to change some things I feel were lacking in the end-game experience of OSB.

Basically, I felt that the experience to get ending 2 and 3 were a bit convoluted and kept players from experiencing the entire story (each ending builds on the other to provide a much more compelling experience) so I wanted to smooth that out.

The goals are still the same, so any knowledge of the game you have acquired through playing is still needed but the quality of life approach to achieving each step necessary, I feel, is much more clean.

I think these changes really amplify the experience of the game while not changing things in a major way. I hope you have a great time and get to uncover the full story of Our Secret Below.

Thank you so much for playing and if you enjoy it, please remember to leave a review! Thank you so much!

-Brian

notes.title: Kohate launch & Mortuary Assistant production started
notes.content:
After I launched Our Secret Below in July, I looked at the calendar and thought it might be cool to try and get a short game in out in time for Halloween. I wanted to jump right into The Mortuary Assistant but figured a few months on MA would not be as impactful as a full new title!

So I started on Kohate. A spin-off of my first project The Subject, Kohate focuses much more on the survival aspect as apposed to the puzzle-heavy aspect of The Subject. It's short, fun, and filled with secrets, lore, and multiple endings.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390490/Kohate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/f601b251d2013305319f2a63debaadf4990dd590.png[/img][/url]

I also have an updated planned with a fourth ending for October 22. Kohate launches today for $4.99! I hope you can go pick it up and be sure to leave a review!

[previewyoutube=7ihvX9E7_P8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Mortuary Assistant[/h3]

Now that Kohate is finished, I have started on full development of The Mortuary assistant! The environment is larger, there will be more dead bodies, and you will actually embalm them! I'm very excited to start on this project as it is very special to me.

There is currently now launch date set other than an aim for spring-summer next year. So be sure to follow my [url=https://twitter.com/DSDigitalDev]Twitter[/url] and keep an eye on development!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390490/Kohate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/f858cfe19ad9d7afdcf31f7a3d85938716febe62.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Full controller support now in OSB!
notes.content:
I've done a number of small adjustments to the game in this update with one larger update being full controller support!

I spent a long time re-working item interaction and computer terminal usage for controller support. The Normal mouse and keyboard experience stays the same but if you switch to a controller, the game will automatically use a virtual keyboard when needed and alter item interaction to suit controller usage.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W5ffhxhpe8NCWZvFCh/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Full List of Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Full Controller Support with virtual keyboard
[*] Tips now display in the loading screen
[*] Adjusted some item placement in the game to improve game flow
[*] Changed some wording in some item descriptions to help guide the player more
[*] More bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35240255/34d8e8147108d5fc9a41b14fe50eef2b8a6c8bbc.png[/img]

Thank you so much for playing Our Secret Below and keep and eye out for a steam page for my new mini game Kohate coming out in October!

-Brian

notes.title: Drop it like it's Hot FIX v1.0.6
notes.content:
Though I have loved trolling with the space bears and the intentional design of having limited item space. I have decided it's better to give the ability to drop items.

The last thing I want is new players thinking the game is unintentionally broken if they accidentally fill their inventory. I feel this solution does not impact the game in a negative way so it's beneficial for all. Enjoy!

[list]
[*] Added ability to drop items. Clilck "drop" button in the pause screen
[/list]

notes.title: Our Secret Below Launching July 10th!
notes.content:
I'm so excited that launch day is approaching! It's been a very hard and long road full of 14 hour or longer work days, stressful kickstarters, and lots and lots of development!

I can't be grateful enough to those who have supported the project both through Kickstarter and through the community. It's exciting to have a solid date for launch. The Builds are up and ready to go, I'm putting together reward packages, and everything is in a good place.

[h1]July 10th[/h1]
[b]10:00am Central time[/b]

After launch, I will be monitoring things for a while to make sure there are no horrible bugs and to see how the game is received. Then I'll be taking  short break to stream a bit more on twitch, dream up some new game ideas, and spend some time with my family.

Thank you again to anyone and everyone who plays the game! I ask that if you play the game and enjoy it to please leave a review. Reviews are very impactful for indie devs and their place in the Steam market.

See you Friday!

-Brian

notes.title: Our Secret Below Kickstarter is live!
notes.content:
[h1]LIVE ON KICKSTARTER!
[/h1]
Our Secret Below is heading to Kickstarter today and I'm very excited for it! I'm hoping that I can raise $3,600 to help me pay for the things that will make OSB the best it can be.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/darkstonedigital/our-secret-below]CHECK OUT THE KICKSTARTER[/url]

[previewyoutube=ABYfrJJ9mxw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Production and cost[/h2]
Production is going smoothly and I want to make sure the final phases of development art just as successful by being able to quickly pay my voice actors for lots of new recordings, pay for a musical score that fits well for the game, and purchase sound FX that are nice and polished to give the game a professional feel.

Finally, I'm going to take a portion of those funds to pay for advertising. Being noticed is very difficult for indie developers and even harder for solo devs as our time is split among many different things.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35240255/ffd1bbb32e036784a12bfb1ad223ebea559aeaf8.png[/img]

[h2]Share and Support[/h2]
So please take a moment to drop by the Kickstarter, share the page, and support if you can. I'm very excited for where Our Secret Below is headed. The game shows lots of promise and is taking form in a great way! Hope to see you there!
